title: Merit of Greeting the Holy Prophet and Lady Fatimah Al-Zahra’

blocks.x: In Tahdhib al-Ahkam, Shaykh al-Tusi (the author) has narrated on the authority of Yazid ibn ‘Abd al-Malik on the authority of his father that his father, once, visited Lady Fatimah al-Zahra’ (‘a) who greeted his first and then asked him about the reason of his visit. “I just seek blessings,” answered he. She said, “My father has informed me that Almighty Allah will decide Paradise for one who greets him and me for three consecutive days.” “Does this means to greet you and him during your lifetimes?” asked he. She answered, “Yes, and also after our death.”
